newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end steady ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end steady ahead of budget.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed steady in thin trading ahead of Thursday's revenue budget for the new fiscal year beginning on July 1, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index dropped 0.19 points or 0.015 percent at 1,145.29 on a turnover of 49.6 million taka. gainers led losers by 82 to 51.
Brokers said the index lost slighty amid profit taking on some blue chips. "The market was dull because investors traded cautiously before the budget," said one broker.
Atlas Bangladesh gained 4.32 taka to 308.05, Wonderland Toys lost 1.19 to 283.67 and Beximco Pharma rose 2.96 to 154.21.
